items.name: Cube Against Cancer Brisbane 2026
items.information:
**This competition is a part of the [Cube Against Cancer](https://www.cubeagainstcancer.org/) competition series in collaboration with [Ethan's Ohana](https://www.ethansohana.org/). We are asking that all competitors bring at least one unopened 3x3 cube or STEM-related item, which will be donated to a pediatric cancer patient. See the [Cube Against Cancer](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubeAgainstCancerBrisbane2026#67602-cube-against-cancer) tab for more information.**

![](https://i.imgur.com/ZIPeEfV.png)

**Contact us**
We are on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/SpeedcubingAustralia/) and [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/speedcubingau/)!

[Speedcubing Australia Website](https://speedcubing.org.au)

Speedcubing Australia acknowledges the traditional owners of this land, the Jagera and Turrbal people, and pays respect to the elders, past and present for they hold the memories, the traditions, the culture and hopes of Aboriginal Australia.

items.information:
Attendance is not required for the entire competition. However, **please arrive at least 15 minutes before the events that you compete in or help in are planned to start**. Please bring your own puzzles for the events you are competing in.

Once your registration has been accepted, you will no longer be able to change your events by yourself. If you would like to change them, send the organization team an email and we will change your events for you as long as you inform us before February 6, 2026 at 6:00 PM MST.

**First-Time Competitors: All newcomers must be familiar with the WCA Regulations before competing.** There is a video [here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww&t=2s&ab_channel=cyotheking) for a basic overview of the rules.

venue.name: Per Brahegymnasiet
venue.details: Tävlingen hålls i matsalen, som är en separat byggnad (Brunnsgatan 3). Alltså inte ingång genom skolans huvudentré.

items.information:
Välkomna till Kublördag Jönköping!

Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter samt oavsett tidigare tävlingserfarenhet. 

Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information.

-----

Welcome to Kublördag Jönköping!

Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior competition experience.

We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information.

[![](https://cuboss.se/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/cuboss-svekub-loggor.png)](https://svekub.se/om_oss/svekub-cuboss/)

items.information:
## This is a FMC-only competition and is not recommended for new competitors. 3x3x3 Fewest Moves will be the only WCA event held. There will be no traditional speedsolving events.

Guests will be allowed but we do not recommend this event for spectators.

items.name: Vanderbilt Winter 2026
items.information:
This competition is supported by [Southeast Cubing, Inc.](https://southeastcubing.org/about), the official nonprofit organization for speedcubing in the Southeast! Please check out the [Southeast Cubing, Inc. tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/VanderbiltWinter2026#60375-southeast-cubing-inc) to learn more about the organization and what you can do to support the mission.

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6Mzc5MDYsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--55d04463db7d97e68854ce1ad4ffb960c1ed23fd/SOUTHEAST_5.png)

## MINORS POLICY: A parent or guardian MUST be present at check-in for anyone under the age of 18 who plans to compete. Vanderbilt University requires all minors (persons under the age of 18) attending this competition to be accompanied by a parent or guardian. All participants under the age of 18 must fill out the form linked below:
# https://forms.gle/cFt7i8vmK9yEA7U2A
**We reserve the right to deny entry into the venue if you have not filled out the form.**
